title: Elon Musk says Starlink’s next-generation laser links will deliver 10 Tbps, up from around 100 Gbps today. That’s a 100-fold increase in link capacity. He also expects Starlink v4 to offer 10 times the capability of v3. https://t.co/7Rwj0BkdZi
